mapper.sql: id, user_id, status, total_count, queued_count, running_count, succeeded_count, skipped_count, failed_count, credentials_ciphertext, create_time, update_time, finish_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_import_batch (user_id, status, total_count, queued_count, running_count, succeeded_count, skipped_count, failed_count, credentials_ciphertext, create_time, update_time, finish_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{queuedCount}, #{runningCount}, #{succeededCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{failedCount}, #{credentialsCiphertext}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{finishTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM video_import_batch WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM video_import_batch WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE video_import_batch b SET queued_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 'QUEUED'), running_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 'RUNNING'), succeeded_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 'SUCCEEDED'), skipped_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 'SKIPPED'), failed_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 'FAILED'), status = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')) THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 'FAILED') THEN 'PARTIAL_FAILED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END, finish_time = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')) THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE b.id = #{id}
UPDATE video_import_batch SET credentials_ciphertext = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COMPLETED'

UPDATE video_import_batch b SET queued_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 'QUEUED'), running_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_import_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 'RUNNING'), status = 'RUNNING', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finish_time = NULL WHERE b.status = 'RUNNING'
